description: This source file implements expression folding logic for a shader compiler, including traversing and replacing foldable expressions such as ternary, aggregate, binary, unary, and swizzle nodes within an abstract syntax tree.

classes.name: FoldExpressionsTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that walks through the AST to fold expressions where possible, replacing nodes with simplified versions.

methods.name: didReplace
methods.description: Returns whether any expression node was replaced during traversal.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares the traverser for the next iteration by resetting the replacement flag.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Visits ternary nodes and attempts to fold them if possible.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes and attempts to fold them if possible.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Visits binary expression nodes and attempts to fold them if possible.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Visits unary expression nodes and attempts to fold them if possible.

methods.name: visitSwizzle
methods.description: Visits swizzle nodes and attempts to fold them if possible.

methods.name: FoldExpressions
methods.description: Main function that performs iterative expression folding on the AST until no more replacements occur.
